new_computer_setup.marketingCopy: A brand-new business computer is only as good as its setup - and out-of-the-box defaults mean the wrong settings, missing updates, unconfigured security, and hours of setup time. The New Computer Setup prepares a new Windows or Mac business computer for productive use: operating system updates, user accounts, software installation, network and printer configuration, email and Microsoft 365 setup, and security basics like encryption and protection. We configure it properly, test it, and hand it over ready for work. Your team gets a computer that's productive on day one instead of spending their first hours configuring it.
bestFor: Businesses buying new computers who want them work-ready
Organizations that want security configured before the computer reaches staff
Companies that want setup handled by professionals instead of trial-and-error
New employees who need a working computer on their first day
whatIsIncluded: Operating system setup and update installation
Software installation for the user's role
Security configuration including encryption and protection
customerOutcomes: A work-ready computer from day one
Security configured before the device reaches the user
Email, software, and peripherals all working
A documented setup instead of an afternoon of configuration

business_laptop_security_setup.marketingCopy: Laptops travel - to home offices, client sites, and coffee shops - which makes them the most likely device to be lost, stolen, or compromised. The Business Laptop Security Setup hardens a laptop before it starts traveling: updates installed, disk encryption enabled, account hygiene cleaned up, screen lock configured, protection software verified, and practical settings applied that reduce risk without frustrating the user. We focus on the security controls that matter most for a portable device carrying business data. Your laptops become secure by default rather than relying on luck.
bestFor: Businesses issuing laptops to remote, field, or traveling staff
Organizations concerned about lost or stolen devices
Companies that want laptop security configured before the device goes into the field
Businesses meeting insurance requirements for device encryption
whatIsIncluded: Screen lock and security policy configuration
Practical security settings that reduce risk without hurting productivity
customerOutcomes: A hardened laptop secure for travel and remote work
Encryption enabled so a lost laptop doesn't mean a data breach
Security settings configured to reduce risk
Insurance-ready laptop security evidence

patch_status_snapshot.marketingCopy: Unpatched software is one of the most exploited vulnerabilities in small business - and most owners have no idea whether their computers are current. The Patch Status Snapshot provides a quick assessment of patch and update status across a small set of devices: which are current, which are behind, and which have critical gaps. We check operating system and key application updates, identify the devices most at risk, and give you a prioritized list of updates to apply. It's a fast, affordable way to close one of the biggest exploit paths before it's used against you.
bestFor: Businesses that have never checked patch status across their devices
Organizations concerned about unpatched software vulnerabilities
Companies that want a quick, affordable security assessment
Businesses preparing for insurance that asks about patch management
whatIsIncluded: Patch status review across a small set of devices
customerOutcomes: A clear picture of which devices are patched and which aren't
Critical update gaps identified before they're exploited
A prioritized list of updates to apply
Patch posture evidence for insurance and compliance

Managed Workstation Essentials is an entry-level recurring workstation care plan: device inventory, basic health review, update verification, and a maintenance cadence that keeps your computers running. It's the foundation level of proactive workstation management - designed for businesses that want a manageable baseline of care without a full managed IT commitment. Your computers get checked, tracked, and maintained on a schedule instead of running until they fail.

Organizations with a modest number of computers to maintain
Companies that want devices tracked and health-checked regularly

warranty_tracking.marketingCopy: Business computers and devices have warranties that expire - and most businesses discover theirs expired only when a device breaks and the repair is no longer covered. The Warranty Tracking service documents your hardware warranties and replacement dates in one place: what's covered, for how long, and when it expires. We inventory your devices, look up warranty status where possible, and create a tracking document with expiration dates and reminders. Warranty coverage is money already spent - and tracking it ensures you use it before it lapses.

data_transfer_service.marketingCopy: Moving to a new computer usually means losing something - an overlooked folder, a browser bookmark, a configuration, or a document that lived only in one place. The Data Transfer Service moves your selected user data from an old computer to a new one completely and safely. We identify what matters - documents, emails, browser data, and application settings - and migrate it to the new machine with verification that everything arrived. You get your new computer with your data intact and nothing left behind on the old one. It's the part of computer replacement that's usually done wrong, done right.

old_device_wipe_coordination.marketingCopy: Old computers hold business data even after they're 'deleted' - files, cached credentials, and recoverable documents survive a simple format.
